verdict.rationale: Airbyte publishes a documented public REST API for programmatic control (used with orchestration tools like Airflow), requires standard access-token auth, and also offers a Terraform provider and PyAirbyte SDK for programmatic/AI-native workflows, plus MCP servers for agent access. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at the probed conventional URLs and independent hands-on corroboration of API robustness.
